cohort: Primi- and multi-gravida women between 37 and 41 weeks of gestation with an unfavourable cervix (Bishop's score 0-2) were included in the study.
finding: Dilapan-S was found to be non-inferior to the Foley balloon in achieving pre-induction cervical ripening in term pregnancies.
mod_finding: The number of vaginal deliveries and cesarean deliveries for failed induction of labor were comparable between the Dilapan-S and Foley balloon groups.
